title: Status of the RBCC Direct-Connect Mixer Combustor Experiment

method: Direct-connect rocket-based combined-cycle mixer combustor tests; report summary only, not raw time series.

units: psia; dimensionless O/F; ft/s; s; BTU/s, as published
uncertainty: Report states uncertainty analysis was still needed; quantified uncertainty UNKNOWN.

license: NASA NTRS record; source terms apply
method: Summary of 67 hot-fire firings; no raw data file claimed here.

units: s; psia; lbf; dimensionless ratio; specific impulse seconds
uncertainty: Summary-level values; detailed uncertainty not provided in record.
limits: Summary report values, not an engine design qualification or independently reprocessed dataset.

method: Analysis of two J-2X diffuser hot-fire tests using accelerometers and strain gauges.
